selection_rule: A candidate must specify its population basis, delay support, normalization convention, source-frame event yields, energy/momentum, metallicity dependence, license, and conversion checksum before approval.

candidates.citation: Maoz, Mannucci & Brandt 2012, The delay-time distribution of Type-Ia supernovae from Sloan II
candidates.imf_convention: Kroupa-like convention in the source analysis; project IMF conversion must be explicit
candidates.population_and_binary_semantics: empirical impulse response; progenitor channel is not uniquely identified
blockers: binary fraction is recorded as bookkeeping only because the empirical DTD normalization already includes the binary population
the selected HESMA event-yield source supplies the event composition; metallicity-sensitive DTD alternatives remain systematic comparisons

candidates.citation: Freundlich & Maoz 2021, The delay time distribution of Type-Ia supernovae in galaxy clusters
candidates.environment_semantics: cluster population; amplitude is reported higher than field by about 2--3
blockers: cluster normalization must not be transferred to field/LRD populations without an environment model
project IMF and binary normalization not yet approved
event-yield source and conversion checksum are not staged

candidates.citation: Dubay, Johnson & Johnson 2024, Galactic Chemical Evolution Models Favor an Extended Type Ia Supernova Delay-Time Distribution
blockers: does not by itself provide a portable project normalization
Milky Way chemical-evolution fit is not an LRD binary prescription
event-yield source and conversion checksum are not staged

candidates.citation: Ruiter, Belczynski & Fryer 2011, Delay times and rates for Type Ia supernovae and thermonuclear explosions from double-detonation sub-Chandrasekhar mass models
candidates.population_and_binary_semantics: explicit binary evolutionary channels and common-envelope assumptions
blockers: binary initial distributions and common-envelope choices must match the project population
event-yield source and conversion checksum are not staged

decision.current_recommendation: Use the field-observed power-law as the baseline candidate for sensitivity design, while retaining the extended-DTD GCE result as a systematic comparison. Do not write either into the production contract yet.
